description: Defines the GLES1Renderer class which emulates GLES1 rendering operations on top of a GLES3 context, including shader management, uniform setting, and rendering state management.

classes.name: GLES1Renderer
classes.description: A final class that handles GLES1 emulation rendering operations, shader management, and state configuration.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the renderer is destroyed.

methods.name: prepareForDraw
methods.description: Prepares the renderer for drawing with specified primitive mode, context, and state.

methods.name: drawTexture
methods.description: Draws a texture at specified position and size.

methods.name: getShader
methods.description: Retrieves a shader object given its handle.

methods.name: getProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a program object given its handle.

methods.name: compileShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader from source code.

methods.name: linkProgram
methods.description: Links shader objects into a program.

methods.name: initializeRendererProgram
methods.description: Initializes the renderer program with shaders and states.

methods.name: setUniform1iv
methods.description: Sets an array of integer uniform values.

methods.name: setUniform1fv
methods.description: Sets an array of float uniforms.

methods.name: setAttributesEnabled
methods.description: Enables vertex attributes based on a mask.
